system.description:
You remove any [Fatigue] you are currently affected by. However, at the end of the scene, you take [Fatigue]. The rating of this [Fatigue] is equal to [Removed (Fatigue) Rating + 10].

(Bonus): You gain +8 [Max HP].

A special skill that demonstrates extraordinary physical strength and pushes away fatigue to forcefully move the body. For a while, you can move around energetically, but fatigue will hit you later.
